outcome: Fetal outcomes (stillbirth, congenital anomalies, fetal weight, COVID-19 status)
finding: Severe COVID-19 infection and adverse maternal-fetal outcomes during the third wave of COVID-19 infection with the Delta variant in Nepal were less than in other regions of the world despite low rates of vaccination.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was slightly higher (51.65%) than normal delivery.
birth_weight: Majority of babies (68.14%) had normal fetal weight
